codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly updates the mobile dashboard route (apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx) to render the full-screen calendar with safe-area coverage and wires drawer actions. The code properly uses the shared MobileCalendarWrapper and handles safe areas and navigation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Skill `mobile-ui-worker` instructs the worker to run `cd ... && bun run ...` for verification. However, the environment uses Windows PowerShell by default where `&&` is invalid syntax, requiring the worker to adapt the command.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: SKILL.md step 6 uses `&&`. The worker's transcript shows an adaptation for PowerShell: `Set-Location "..."; bun run typecheck; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; bun run lint`.

summary: Review passed. The code correctly implements the main authenticated mobile dashboard screen with safe area insets and proper integration of the MobileCalendarWrapper.
